answers.evidence:
Built a self-contained reproduction (`/tmp/go-cli-flag-overrides`, Go 1.26, `go vet` clean, `gofmt` clean) and verified both unit and live behavior:

**Automated — 18/18 test executions pass** (6 test functions incl. 12 table subtests): spec flag surface present; 9 override cases; 3 log-level defaulting cases; unknown-flag errors; missing-config fail-fast; live bind test.

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| No flags → YAML untouched | `port=8080 sock=/var/run/docker.sock level=debug` preserved |
| `--port 9091` only | port overridden; socket + level still from YAML |
| `--docker-sock` / `--log-level` individually | only that field overridden |
| All three flags together | all overridden |
| Sentinels `--port 0`, `--docker-sock ""`, `--log-level ""` explicitly passed | YAML **not** clobbered (verified live: bound on YAML port, not 0) |
| `--log-level` absent everywhere | resolves to `info` |
| Unknown flag | clean usage error, no silent swallow |
| Missing config file | fail-fast error, no default fallback |
| Port conflict (env service on 8080) | fail-fast `bind: address already in use` — never silently hijacks |

**Live runs** (real TCP binds, health endpoint inspected via curl):
- `./cli --config cfg.yaml --port 9091` → `ok port=9091 log=debug sock=/var/run/docker.sock` — **`--port 9091` bound correctly**, flag wins over YAML 8080.
- No `--port` → YAML port binds; `--port 0`/`--docker-sock ""` → YAML values survive.
- `--port P --docker-sock /tmp/x.sock --log-level trace` → `ok port=P log=trace sock=/tmp/x.sock`.

**Signature-change risk:** `grep` confirms exactly one `framework.New(` call site (`main.go:106`) and **zero** test callers of `framework.New` — the added `logLevel` parameter compiles cleanly with no collateral test breakage.
